overall.verdict: A rare wallet that explains its own risk model (green enforceable vs violet promised) with genuine evidentiary depth — proofs, frames, co-signatures — which most shipping products never attempt. It is held back by jargon leaks (frames, committed entries, EntityProvider), repeated color-only risk encoding, several broken layouts (06b overlap, 15 overflow, 16 clipping), and heavy dense explainers at exactly the moments users are most stressed.
priority_fixes: Fix the three broken surfaces: opaque 06b dispute modal, clipped 15-sovereignty counterparty card, clipped 16-desk book column
Replace color-only risk encoding everywhere with labeled bars/legend text (accessibility + Rosa/Ingrid)
Translate protocol jargon (frames, committed entries, EntityProvider, bar scale px) into plain language with raw data behind 'Advanced'
Standardize one balance snapshot and one legend vocabulary (settled/pending/open, secured/promised) across Home, Manage, Activity, Desk
Convert the cross-network swap and dispute flows into explicit numbered steppers with hold-to-confirm on irreversible actions
